title: Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen says he would ‘entertain’ broadcasting career

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen says he would ‘entertain’ broadcasting career
sources.description: Buffalo Bills QB Josh Allen says he would “entertain” a post-NFL career in broadcasting, joining the ranks of former quarterbacks like Tom Brady, Drew Brees, Matt Ryan, Tony Romo and Troy Aikman.
